reasons.claim: 1.72 ha regeneration felling notification, status notified; no completed felling overlaps the polygon (0%).

One eligible species, Sclerophora peronella (VU, site-bound lichen; threats include lack of old trees, continuity forest and dead wood), is recorded 765 m from the polygon (uncertainty 5 m, year 2016). None are eligible within 250 m.
Site-bound forest NT lichens (Lobaria pulmonaria, Lecanora glabrata, Pyrenula nitida) are recorded at 698-816 m, all beyond 250 m, so the 3-NT-within-250 m criterion is not met.
No records exist inside the polygon or within 250 m (0 records, 0 days). 1000 m effort is above the county median (163 vs 54), so effort is adequate.

uncertainties: The eligible record is from 2016 and 765 m away; it does not show the lichen's current status or presence on the site.
39 records were dropped for coordinate uncertainty, so some nearby records may be missing from the analysis.
Zero near-site records with adequate 1000 m effort is still not absence of species.
not_established: Whether any red-listed species occurs on the notified polygon.
The habitat or age of the stand.
That the site is safe to fell.
next_action: Reviewer should inspect the stand for old trees and other habitat values for lichens, given the nearby VU Sclerophora peronella and NT lichens at 700-800 m. A field check is useful because no records exist near the site.
